name: Guatapé
tagline: Painted town and the giant rock of El Peñol
summary: Guatapé is a cheerful lakeside town whose houses are decorated with colourful relief panels called zócalos. Climb the 740 steps of the giant El Peñol rock for a view over the island-studded reservoir, take a boat around the lake, and wander the painted lanes.
seasonNote: Drier December to February and July to August; weekends are busy with day-trippers from Medellín.
arrival: About 2 hours by bus from Medellín's north terminal.
cashTip: Carry pesos for small places and transport; cards work in hotels. A 10 percent service is often suggested on the bill.
foodTip: Bandeja paisa, lake trout and arepas.
